title: Gojo, off duty
medium: Digital ink with screentone and one spot of colour
description: Gojo swaps the blindfold for his round sunglasses and that famous grin. The artist keeps everything in black, white and grey tones so the single blue eye peeking over the lenses does all the talking.

title: Deku, ready for anything
medium: Traditional colour illustration on textured paper
description: Deku in his hero costume with the yellow scarf and gauntlets, brushing back his hair with a quiet smile. The paper grain and layered greens give it a warm, hand-made feel.

title: Ghost
description: Ghost seen from behind in his skull balaclava and cloak, one red eye glancing back. Flat colour shapes and a grey backdrop keep the focus on that iconic silhouette.
